rationale: The fixed implementation adds a bounds/overflow validation for the shared-memory data range before creating the observer and scheduling completion notification. The Logic section says only that the function retrieves and validates a shared-memory buffer, sets up memory parameters, creates an observer, requests notification, and queues the operation. Its buffer-validity statement is satisfied by the null shared-memory check present in both versions and does not specifically describe the fixed-only range validation. All other stated operations are common to both implementations.
